newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico Four Corners 755 MW unit seen up Tues.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico Four Corners 755 MW unit seen up Tues.

text.p: The 755 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Four Corners coal-fired power plant in New Mexico will likely back up Tuesday after tripping off line Sunday when a booster fan failed, sources familiar with the unit said Monday.
The unit was tentatively scheduled to restart around noon on Tuesday, they said.
Unit 5 at Four Corners was said to be operating about 50 MW below its 750 MW level due to emissions restrictions.
The plant's three smaller units were said to be running near capacity at 186 MW, 187 MW and 244 MW, the sources said.
Arizona Public Service owns Four Corners units 1, 2, and 3 and holds a 15 percent interest in units 4 and 5.
Southern California Edison Co holds a 48 percent stake in units 4 and 5.
